coverage_limits: This follow-up uses targeted public web searches, full source retrieval where available, and a bounded official X archive search. It is not an exhaustive search of all recordings or archives.
Only the two existing verified account mappings support direct author searches. Other X queries use names and agency terms as discovery leads; a mention never establishes account ownership.
Zero retrieved evidence does not establish neutrality, opposition, silence or absence of public views.
Source reviews check exact quotation and attribution. Model review does not independently prove factual claims in the quoted source.
